text:
lee (People Ops): leaving an open thread for questions from today’s all-hands about hybrid logistics, parking, offsites, and the new travel/remote pilots — drop quick Qs here and we'll follow up. :loudspeaker:
arjun (Eng): quick one: the sign-up for commuter parking in SF — is it first-come-first-served each month or can teams reserve blocks for interview days?
lee (People Ops): FCFS by default. Teams can request a temporary block for interview days; fill out the form linked in the doc and ops-team will review. Expect 48h turnaround.
dana (Marketing): who owns paying for candidate parking? recruiting or hiring team?
tom (Recruiting): hiring team covers interview-day parking unless it's a recruiting-hosted event, then Recruiting covers. We'll add a short table to the policy.
zoe (HR): tiny note on accessibility: if anyone needs an accessible parking spot for an applicant, ping HR and wean reserve it automatically.
arjun (Eng): thanks. another: any update on the monthly co-working stipend pilot for remote folks? saw a slide but didn't catch the follow-up steps.
lee (People Ops): good catch — pilot starts Aug 1. $100/month stipend for people who don't have a regular desk reservation and who work from a verified third-party coworking space. Requires monthly attestation. We'll post signup next week.
dana (Marketing): does stipend stack with offsite per-diem or is it mutually exclusive?
lee (People Ops): mutually exclusive for the same days (can't claim both for same dates). We'll include a FAQ entry.
expense-bot: Reminder: submit receipts within 30 days or the report will be auto-closed.
arjun (Eng): small policy Q: if we do a 2-night team offsite and some folks extend personal travel, do we reimburse extra hotel nights?
lee (People Ops): company reimburses nights directly related to the offsite. Personal extensions are out-of-pocket; if someone needs to combine trips we can approve exceptions case-by-case but require manager + finance sign-off before booking.
tom (Recruiting): visa letters: is the new process still via ops@redwood? i need one for a contractor candidate next week.
zoe (HR): yes ops@redwood, cc your recruiter. Standard turnaround is 3 business days; mark "expedite" in the subject for urgent cases.
arjun (Eng): any change to badge/door access for satellite hubs? One of our contractors couldn't get in last week.
lee (People Ops): badges are now auto-provisioned for contractors with >30 days onsite planned; otherwise request via ops-team. For immediate one-off access, ops-team can create day passes.
dana (Marketing): will the company cover family travel for UX researchers when user studies require minors/guardians?
lee (People Ops): currently we cover participant-facing travel and researcher travel for field studies; family/guardian travel is considered personal unless it's essential to the study. Submit a case to people-ops with details and we'll route to Finance for approval.
arjun (Eng): ping on noise policy in hubs — i'm hearing complaints about long calls in quiet zones.
lee (People Ops): ask teams to use reservable phone booths first; hubs will get a refreshed signage pack and a short etiquette reminder email. We'll trial a 2-week "quiet hours" test at one hub in September.
ops-team: If you want venue vetting for offsites, send dates + expected headcount to ops-team@redwood and we'll send recommended vendors and an accessibility checklist.
lee (People Ops): Thanks all — we'll put a summarized follow-up in #announcements and update the travel/hybrid doc this week. If you need immediate help DM me or tag @people-ops. :white_check_mark:
